vida-recepcion.papel: H2 · recepción: orientación de senderos en un mostrador abierto bajo la pinada.
vida-recepcion.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Cala Sereno demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of a small, personal reception conversation in the same Mediterranean pine campsite as the approved Cala Sereno assets.
Input images: hero-dia.webp is the exact sandy pine-grove light and material reference; tipo-bungalow.webp is the restrained timber reference.
Scene/backdrop: A modest open-sided reception counter made of pale timber under mature Aleppo pines, compacted sand underfoot and the sea only faintly glimpsed between trunks; no hotel lobby.
Subject: A receptionist aged 45–65 points out a walking option on a plain folded paper map with no readable detail to two adult guests carrying small unbranded daypacks; all three are absorbed in the map rather than posing.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 50 mm lens, quiet grain and the muted pine-green, sand and sea-blue palette of Cala Sereno.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, waist-up conversation slightly off-centre with enough campsite context; all important action inside the central 70 percent for mobile crop.
Lighting/mood: Soft mid-morning dappled shade, familiar and practical rather than staged.
Constraints: Plausible hands and paper contact, anonymous non-frontal faces, simple fully covering everyday clothes, believable campsite scale.
Avoid: hotel uniforms, queue, computers with text, readable map, signs, logos, branded gear, posed smiles, luxury materials, extra fingers, HDR, glossy resort advertising, watermark.

Subject: A server in plain unbranded clothes carefully sets a shallow clay rice pan at a multigenerational table of four adults; the diners make room naturally and continue their conversation without looking at camera.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 50 mm lens, restrained colour, believable food and hand contact, subtle 35 mm grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, the shared serving gesture is central while the canvas, pines and strip of sea remain unmistakable; mobile-safe central action.
Lighting/mood: Warm but soft early-afternoon shade, convivial and unhurried.
Constraints: Plausible anatomy and tableware, anonymous side-view people, simple Mediterranean lunch, preserve the approved terrace geometry and material palette.
Avoid: fine-dining theatre, paella spectacle, chef hat, champagne, overloaded food, readable menus, logos, uniforms with brands, frontal smiles, extra fingers, HDR, luxury cliché, watermark.

vida-servicio-cala.papel: H2 · cala: huéspedes alcanzan la pequeña playa a pie desde la pinada.
vida-servicio-cala.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Cala Sereno demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of campsite guests reaching a small Castellón pebble cove on foot through the same mature pine grove as Cala Sereno.
Input images: hero-dia.webp is the exact dappled pine-grove light, compacted sandy path and restrained coastal colour reference.
Scene/backdrop: A narrow unpaved path descends gently between Aleppo pines to a modest clear-water cove with rounded stones, no road crossing and no private beach furniture.
Subject: One adult and two older children aged roughly 10–15 walk away from camera toward the water carrying plain rolled towels and a reusable bottle; another adult follows a few steps behind at an easy pace.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, muted pine green, pale stone and calm sea blue, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, the path leads from foreground to the cove; figures remain secondary and inside the central 70 percent for mobile crop.
Lighting/mood: Clear late morning with cool tree shade, simple anticipation rather than holiday advertising.
Constraints: Everyone fully clothed in ordinary summer walking clothes, back or side view, plausible gait and limbs, coherent shadows, environmentally credible cove.
Avoid: swimwear posing, looking back, tropical sand, beach club, umbrellas, logos, readable signs, crowd, malformed limbs, extreme turquoise, HDR, travel-poster saturation, watermark.

vida-entorno.papel: H2 · entorno: dos senderistas salen desde recepción hacia el pinar alto.
vida-entorno.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Cala Sereno demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of two adult guests beginning a marked coastal walk directly from the same Cala Sereno pine campsite.
Input images: hero-dia.webp is the exact Aleppo-pine canopy, pale compacted path, morning light and quiet campsite material reference.
Scene/backdrop: The campsite edge opens into a dry Mediterranean footpath with rosemary, limestone and a distant glimpse of the bay; no invented monument or dramatic cliff.
Subject: Two adults aged roughly 35–60 walk away at an easy pace with small plain daypacks; one adjusts a shoulder strap while the other studies the natural fork in the path, without a visible branded sign.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 50 mm lens, subdued pine green, limestone and sea blue, subtle 35 mm grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, path and landscape dominate; the two figures sit within the central 60 percent and remain anonymous.
Lighting/mood: Fresh early morning, quiet and practical, distinct from golden-hour resort imagery.
Constraints: Fully covering walking clothes, plausible gait and hands, coherent terrain and shadows, preserve Cala Sereno's intimate pine-grove scale.
Avoid: heroic mountaineering, trekking poles, cliff-edge danger, readable wayfinding, logos, branded gear, frontal faces, malformed limbs, orange sunset, HDR, travel-poster saturation, watermark.
